prediction: no survivor: PF under 1.0 at 2c in most cells; most cells will print 'no evidence at n = x' (about 308 events with a quote in the window across 12 bands, so n under 100 in nearly every cell)
kill: no cell with PF 1.3 at 2c and halves 1.0 or more, n 100, 10 days; kill_fast drops the family at PF under 1.0 at 2c on the first read

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days, events (distinct hourly events of the cell); nobody writes 'survivor' on n alone

rules.two_sided: 0 < bid < ask < 1 for the side taken (rule 18)
rules.cheap_side: the lower ask of the two sides at the look (the YES ask against 1 minus the YES bid); a tie goes to YES
rules.look: the candle ending exactly at close minus 120 s (end_ts); none = no entry for that event (a candle exists only if the minute had a ladder row; its quote can be up to 59 s older than the candle end); no earlier candle is used
rules.exit_M60: the bid of the candle ending exactly at close minus 60 s; none = held to settlement (both printed); a missing candle at exactly that minute is not replaced by the previous one
rules.spread_filter: the engine's own: the spread (ask minus bid, whole cents rounded up) of the entry candle in three classes low, mid, high, with the two cuts computed from the SEARCH phase spreads (engine1_enum.spread_cuts: the ceil(n/3)-th and ceil(2n/3)-th sorted value); no fixed 0.03 cutoff (that earlier wording is withdrawn)
rules.void: a void result is passed through by the loader and scored: the price is refunded and the fee kept
rules.count_96: 12 bands x (filter none + spread low + spread mid + spread high = 4) x 2 exits (H, M60) x 1 side rule (cheap) x 1 bucket (120) = 96; the earlier text '12 x 2 x 2 x 2' counted the filter and side differently and is corrected here
rules.phases: SEARCH and VALIDATE are the engine's own split inside the development window: the first floor(D/2) distinct UTC close dates are SEARCH, the rest VALIDATE (D = distinct close dates of KXETHD with a quote, at most 19, from the loader's count; a dated constant for series ETHD is added to engine1_split by Desk A before any read); the forward window Nov 16 to Dec 16 is a third, later read by the one survivor
rules.entries: one entry per MARKET (strike ticker) per rule, as the engine's groups() does, NOT one per hourly event: several strikes of one event can each enter the same cell; they are correlated, which is why the z is day-clustered. Earlier text saying 'one entry per hourly event' is withdrawn
rules.band: band k = the cheap side's ask in whole cents rounded UP (ceil of 100 x raw ask at 1e-6) with a // 5 == k: band k holds a in [5k, 5k+4], so bands 1 to 12 span a = 5 to 64 (raw ask above 0.04 up to 0.64); entries are scored at the RAW ask
rules.gate: C8: n >= 100, PF at 2c >= 1.3, both 2c halves (first and second floor(n/2) by close_ts then ticker) >= 1.0, trade days >= 10, distinct hourly EVENTS (UTC close times) of the cell in the phase >= 40 (strikes of one event are correlated; Auditor B, Nov 16), signals a day in SEARCH >= 3; PF at 1c is printed, not gated; BH over m_total on the VALIDATE 2c day-clustered p
rules.spread_pool: per bucket: every strike in the SEARCH half whose candle ending at close - bucket is two-sided (0 < bid < ask < 1): its YES spread (ask minus bid) in whole cents rounded up; c1 = the ceil(n/3)-th and c2 = the ceil(2n/3)-th sorted value; low <= c1, mid <= c2, high above; the same cuts apply to VALIDATE
